title: BusductTherMo — BMS Integration Domain (cfg/integration)
description: Fourth independently-versioned config domain (Slice 11). Describes how the panel exposes its live state to a customer Building Management System: enabled protocols (Modbus TCP first, native BACnet later), TCP listener, exposure tier, the append-only point-map version, and zone-rollup rules. The register map itself is GENERATED deterministically from cfg/joints + this domain (src/integration/register-map.js), so joint-count changes need no schema or code edit. Works with the internet down — the BMS is often the customer's alarm path of record. Follows the same store/validate/audit path as the other three domains; validated by rules I1–I5 (src/config-service/validate-integration.js).

modbus_tcp.description: Modbus TCP slave (server) listener the off-the-shelf Modbus→BACnet gateway polls.

enabled.description: Master on/off for the whole BMS interface.

port.description: TCP listen port. 502 is the Modbus default; >=1024 avoids needing a privileged bind (I2 warns on <1024).

unit_id.description: Modbus unit/slave id the gateway addresses (single logical device).

bind_host.description: Optional interface to bind (e.g. the BMS VLAN address). Absent -> bind all interfaces.

config_domain_versions.description: Per-domain applied version. Only 'integration' is authoritative for this domain; the others may be echoed for cross-checking.

exposure_tier.description: How much of the generated map to expose: 1 = summary block only (~12 points); 2 = summary + per-zone; 3 = summary + per-zone + per-joint detail. Higher tiers are a strict superset of the lower ones (append-only), so raising the tier never renumbers existing points.

point_map_version.description: Version of the customer-facing register map (docs/bms-register-map.md). APPEND-ONLY: never renumber a point, only append. I4 forbids this from decreasing across an apply — a decrease would mean a renumber that breaks every deployed gateway configuration.

severity_bitmap.description: Optional compact per-joint severity block: 8 joints packed per 16-bit register (2 bits/joint), for point-licence-sensitive customers who cannot afford Tier-3 detail. Additive; does not change any other block.

zone_rollup.description: Per-zone rollup rules for the Tier-2 block.

worst_joint_tiebreak.description: How the latched worst-joint point resolves a tie when two joints sit at the same level. Only 'first_raised' is defined (first to reach the level holds it until it clears) — it stops the point oscillating. Declared explicitly so the behaviour is a config contract, not an implementation accident.

include_ambient_zone.description: Whether the synthetic AMBIENT zone gets its own Tier-2 block. Off by default (ambient references aren't alarmable joints).
